items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: No, well -- Lockjaw was always going and coming, more or less.

ctx.x: Well, what happened -- Lockjaw was in the band, and then he wasn't in the band, and Frank Foster and Frank Wess were? Can you remember?
No, well -- Lockjaw was always going and coming, more or less.
